title: Pin the measured socket ceiling after the susi top cut
goal: Vision: V-10. Mandate 84. With core's susi top cut (f0c785938) and the daemon handler cut on main, core measures 288,151 complete-socket lines against a pinned 288,877; lower COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING to the measured number so the cuts stay won.

reuse.searched: tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs pins the ceiling and prints the measured number; nothing to build.

limitations: Measured on Windows x86_64 at core main 4d7f6b741 plus nothing else; the ceiling only goes down.
